THE ESSENTIALS

Why Outsource Your Bookkeeping?

With the introduction of Corporate Tax, the UAE has shifted to a strictly regulated tax environment. Every business, regardless of size or Freezone status, is now legally required to maintain accurate financial records for up to 5 years.

Professional bookkeeping is no longer optional. By outsourcing your accounting to ADVAQ, you ensure your books are meticulously maintained according to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). We handle the data entry, reconciliations, and reporting, so you can focus entirely on scaling your business without fearing an FTA audit.

The ADVAQ Edge

  • **Tax-Ready Output:** Accounts formatted specifically for UAE Corporate Tax and VAT returns.
  • **Cost Efficiency:** Avoid the overheads of hiring a full-time, visa-sponsored accountant.
  • **Actionable Insights:** Receive monthly profit & loss statements to make informed decisions.
THE RISK

The Cost of Poor Record-Keeping

Inaccurate or missing financial records expose your business to severe penalties and operational bottlenecks in the UAE.

FTA Audit Fines

Failure to keep required records under UAE tax law triggers an automatic penalty of AED 10,000 for the first offense, escalating to AED 50,000 for repeat violations.

Tax Assessment Risks

Without proper books, you cannot accurately claim legitimate business expenses or Small Business Relief, resulting in overpaying Corporate Tax.

Blind Decision Making

Relying solely on your bank balance rather than a Profit & Loss statement masks true profitability, leading to cash flow crises and poor investment choices.

THE SOLUTION

Our Comprehensive Bookkeeping Package

A full-stack accounting department, available at a fraction of the cost.

Data Entry & Ledger Maintenance

Accurate logging of all sales, purchases, and expenses into industry-standard accounting software.

Bank & Gateway Reconciliation

Matching your accounting records with bank statements and payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal) to prevent missing funds.

Financial Statement Preparation

Accounts Payable/Receivable

VAT Categorisation

Ensuring all inputs and outputs are correctly flagged with standard, zero, or exempt VAT rates for easy returns.

Dedicated Account Manager

Direct access to a financial expert who understands your business model and answers your queries promptly.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Under UAE Corporate Tax Law and VAT regulations, it is mandatory for businesses to maintain accurate financial records for up to 5 years (or more for real estate). Professional bookkeeping ensures your ledgers are FTA-compliant, minimizing the risk of severe penalties during a tax audit.

No. Even if your revenue falls below the Corporate Tax or VAT registration thresholds, or if you qualify for Small Business Relief, you are legally obligated to maintain accurate financial statements and keep records of all transactions.

We recommend monthly or quarterly updates depending on your transaction volume and VAT return filing frequency. Keeping books updated regularly allows for accurate cash flow analysis and ensures readiness for tax submissions.

We are proficient in leading cloud-based accounting software including Xero, QuickBooks Online, and Zoho Books. We can help you set up the software, migrate data, and maintain your books securely in the cloud.

No. Outsourcing your bookkeeping to a professional firm like ADVAQ is much more cost-effective. You save on visa, salary, and office space costs while benefiting from the expertise of seasoned financial professionals.

You will need to provide bank statements, sales invoices, purchase receipts, expense claims, and payroll records. We provide a secure digital portal to easily upload these documents.

Our core bookkeeping package focuses on maintaining ledgers, reconciling banks, and preparing financial statements. We do offer dedicated VAT return filing as an add-on or within our comprehensive packages.

Yes. We offer historical bookkeeping services to reconstruct your accounts from past bank statements and receipts to ensure your books are completely up-to-date and FTA compliant.

FTA-compliant bookkeeping means your financial records are maintained according to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as mandated by the UAE Federal Tax Authority. This includes proper charting of accounts, accurate categorisation of VAT, and maintaining proper audit trails.

We use encrypted, industry-standard cloud accounting software (like Xero or QuickBooks). Your financial data is securely backed up and restricted to authorized professionals only.
